people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
translations.bsb: Jeroboam also built shrines on the high places and appointed from every class of people priests who were not Levites.
translations.kjv: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
translations.asv: And he made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, that were not of the sons of Levi.
